# Technologent IT Solutions Blog

> Enterprise-focused technology blog covering AI governance, cybersecurity, infrastructure modernization, and industry solutions.

Technologent's blog provides practical guidance on emerging technologies like agentic AI, edge computing, and zero-trust security, alongside industry-specific solutions for healthcare and hospitality. The site features thought leadership from Technologent executives and recognition of the company's industry achievements.

## Key Topics

- Agentic AI
- AI Governance
- Zero Trust
- Edge AI
- GenAI
- ITSM
- AI Security
- Data Governance
- Cybersecurity
- VMware Migration
- MLOps & AgentOps
- Healthcare IT
- Data Management
- Wi-Fi 7
- Machine Identity

## AI & Governance

- [Agentic AI Is Revolutionizing IT Service Management](https://blog.technologent.com/agentic-ai-is-revolutionizing-it-service-management): Agentic AI for ITSM automation and autonomous IT operations
- [Agentic AI Is Creating an Identity Crisis](https://blog.technologent.com/agentic-ai-is-creating-an-identity-crisis): Agentic AI identity management and machine identity security risks
- [A Governance Framework Is Essential for AI-Powered ITSM](https://blog.technologent.com/a-governance-framework-is-essential-for-ai-powered-itsm): AI governance framework for IT Service Management and agentic AI
- [Do I Even Know How AI/GenAI Actually Works?](https://blog.technologent.com/do-i-even-know-how-ai/genai-actually-works): Beginner-friendly guide to AI fundamentals, LLMs and neural networks
- [MLOps and AgentOps: Two New Entries in the XOps Lexicon](https://blog.technologent.com/mlops-and-agentops-two-new-entries-in-the-xops-lexicon): MLOps and AgentOps framework for AI deployment and model management
- [Synthetic Data Can Create Very Real Risks](https://blog.technologent.com/synthetic-data-can-create-very-real-risks): Synthetic data risks and GDPR/CCPA compliance for AI training
